The deepseek model successfully audited the same file and found it safe. The openrouter model (advisory) also suffered a parsing error on the PKGBUILD but does not count toward the vote.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review skip-native-embed-for-aur.patch due to an API error (HTTP 400).
openrouter model (advisory) failed to parse the PKGBUILD decision.
learnings: Transient API errors or parsing failures should not permanently block a package verdict if another model in the ensemble successfully reviews the problematic file.
